inspiration: Terrain edge blending by priority: the higher-priority terrain is alpha-masked over the lower to make a transition tile (doc/media/blendomatic.md:21). Shape for zone border looks with our own priority values.
Terrain as a numbered catalogue with priority and tile count per type (doc/media/terrain.md:10). Shape for a biome data table.
Unit stat row: armour split into melee and pierce, attack-type letter, bonus-vs-class text (doc/reverse_engineering/unit_stats/unit_stats_aoc.csv:1). Shape for catalogue fields (row 21).
Viewcone line of sight: units cannot see behind buildings and hidden units break cover only on attack (doc/ideas/gameplay.md:207-215). Idea for stealth and ambush visibility.
Pinned comparator: two armies auto-fight to the end with no player input (doc/ideas/gameplay.md:159). Shape for a duel bench.
Ambient weather and day-night as view-distance and darkness rules (doc/ideas/gameplay.md:11-30). Relevant to ambience.
Minimap symbols for points of interest instead of colours (doc/ideas/interface.md:12-14). Relevant to hud-ui.
Wildlife startle: a flock scatters when a tree is felled, and the sound carries further than sight (doc/ideas/gameplay.md:35). Relevant to sound-music and spawns.

briefs.label: scatter wildlife
briefs.why: a cheap sign of distant activity that the ear picks up first
briefs.keep: idle wildlife, a trigger, a scatter, a sound that carries further than sight
briefs.change: a different creature family and silhouette, our own trigger (a fight nearby), a different flight pattern

briefs.label: reed waiter
briefs.why: a unit that waits in cover and reveals on its first action
briefs.keep: hidden to some observers only; reveal on attack
briefs.change: our own LOS rule and silhouette, a different hiding prop, a visible tell before reveal

briefs.label: auto-duel bench
briefs.why: two forces fight to the end with no input, useful for balance
briefs.keep: mirror match, winner-takes-all, no player input
briefs.change: runs on the server engine as a bench tool, not a player mode

briefs.label: ember on timber
briefs.why: flammable structures can catch and need a counter
briefs.keep: a fire that can be lit, and a counter that puts it out
briefs.change: spark source from our own effect, no spies, a different spread rule

briefs.label: priority border tile
briefs.why: a clean transition tile between two terrains with a stated priority order
briefs.change: our own priority values and mask shapes, applied to zone borders
